indicator_name: Industrial Production Index: Mining and Quarrying
methodology: Derived from the item-level dataset INDUSTRIAL_PRODUCTION_INDEX_BY_ACTIVITY, item B. Codes follow ОКЭД (05, 06.1, 10.5, 24.4 …); IND is the industry total, MACH the machinery group 26–30. The scalar IND_PROD, IND_PROD_MINING/_MANUFACTURING/_ELECTRICITY series are derived from items IND, B, C, D of this dataset (the JSON cube 5809 they used to read stopped at 2023).
